title: Reapportioned envelope surface-semantics assay
campaign_question: Can one authored external morphology retain its silhouette while FLUX assigns deformable and plausibly rigid surface classes?

source.custody_note: Exact operator-selected Blender viewport screenshot, preserved without crop, cleanup, or rerender so all cells share one pixel-identical conditioning source.

conditions.prompt: This creature wearing rigid plate armor.
This creature with a hard shell over its back.
This creature made of fitted stone plates.

claim_ceiling: The twelve cells can establish whether these short prompts preserve the authored silhouette while producing visually separable surface semantics. They cannot establish deformation behavior, automatic rigid-region segmentation, or production generality.
visual_review: Inspect every returned cell before operator presentation. Present source, exact prompt, settings, seed, effective route identity, output, and classification together.
